title: 咖啡店点单
subtitle_en: Can I get a medium coffee to go?
goal_text: 在咖啡店用英语点单、问价格，并能临时改单。
brief_cn: 柜台点单是最低成本的开口练习。学完你能说清杯型和奶糖、选打包还是堂食、问总价，还能在队伍里礼貌改一句“换成大杯”。

vocab.example_en: Can I change that to a large?
Can I change that to a large?

briefing.ref_text: Can I get a medium coffee?
briefing.accept_notes: get a 与 medium 连读自然，词尾 /m/ 到位即可。
to 与 go 之间不断开，please 轻读。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，把这单咖啡的要求说出来。
briefing.ref_text: I want a medium coffee with cream and no sugar. I'll take it to go.
briefing.translation_cn: 我要一杯中杯咖啡，加奶不加糖，带走。
briefing.reference_answer: Medium coffee, cream, no sugar, to go.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出杯型、奶或糖、to go 三个信息点即算通过，词不必全对。
How much 开头即算通过，不必加 in total。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：能换成大杯吗？
briefing.reference_answer: Can I change that to a large?
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 change ... to a large 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 add 说一句你想再加点什么。
briefing.accept_notes: 含 add 并说出要加的东西即算通过。

mission.persona_cn: 咖啡店店员，语速快，会连着问杯型、奶糖、堂食还是打包
mission.context_cn: 早高峰的柜台。店员会一项项问你：要多大杯、加不加奶糖、在这儿喝还是带走、还要别的吗。没听清可以说 Please say that again.
mission.opening_a: Hi there. Can I get you something today?

exchanges.a: Hi there. Can I get you something today?
exchanges.b: Can I get a medium coffee?
Can I change that to a large?

exchanges.a: You got it. Six in total.
exchanges.b: Sure. Can I pay by card?

exchanges.a: Of course. Your name for the cup?
exchanges.b: It's Lee. Thanks, have a good one.
exchanges.a_cn: 当然。杯子上写什么名字？
exchanges.b_cn: 我姓李。谢啦，祝你今天愉快。

tasks.desc_cn: 点一杯咖啡并说清杯型
tasks.hint_en: Can I get a medium coffee?
tasks.hint_cn: 直接说 want 或 Can I get，加 small / medium / large。

tasks.desc_cn: 说明奶、糖和打包还是堂食
tasks.hint_en: With cream, no sugar. To go, please.
tasks.hint_cn: 两短句就够：With / No ...；To go 或 For here。
别忘了问价，这也是一次开口的机会。

tasks.hint_en: Can I change that to a large, and add a cookie?
tasks.hint_cn: 改单说 Can I change ... to ...；加购说 add a ...。
